Unnest a Nested JSON Array Field from a Hue Response

Source: R/request.R
hue_unnest_array.Rd

Uses tidyjson to enter and expand a nested array property (such as "children", "services", "actions", "channels", or "locations") stored inside the ..JSON payload of a tbl_json object returned by huer.

Usage

hue_unnest_array(x, col)

Arguments

x

A tbl_json object returned by hue_parse_response() or any hue_get_*() function.

col

Character scalar. Name of the nested JSON array key to expand (e.g., "children" or "services").

Value

A tbl_json tibble with one row per element of the nested array, preserving parent columns and spreading array element fields.

See also

hue_parse_response()

Examples

room_json <- paste0(
  '{"errors":[],"data":[{"id":"room-1","type":"room",',
  '"metadata":{"name":"Living Room"},',
  '"children":[{"rid":"dev-1","rtype":"device"},',
  '{"rid":"dev-2","rtype":"device"}]}]}'
)
rooms <- hue_parse_response(room_json)
hue_unnest_array(rooms, "children")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   ..JSON                   id     type  metadata.name rid   rtype 
#>   <chr>                    <chr>  <chr> <chr>         <chr> <chr> 
#> 1 "{\"rid\":\"dev-1\",..." room-1 room  Living Room   dev-1 device
#> 2 "{\"rid\":\"dev-2\",..." room-1 room  Living Room   dev-2 device
